title: Variant
description: One point in the P1 design space, hashed so that 'which design won' has an exact answer. The controls are not optional: SHORT_PROSE separates the pointer mechanism from simply decoding fewer tokens, and CPU_LEXICAL separates LLM selection from deterministic lexical selection. Without both, a win cannot be attributed to the P1 idea rather than to output length.

variant_id.description: Registry label, e.g. H03, C02, C05-FUSED-EXT, P0.

node.description: C_VISIBLE is the compressor-only experiment. C_REGISTRY additionally changes evidence visibility and may never be reported as compressor-only. C_FUSED_EXT changes the stopping policy as well as the reducer and carries its own arm and comparator.

scope.description: How candidates are partitioned across selector calls. whole_batch is the one the H/C mechanism contract specifies -- one selector request per gather batch, under one rendered-token budget. per_page and per_tool_call fan out below the batch and therefore multiply the effective batch budget by the number of calls they make; they are retained because the shipped Freeze-1 arms ran on them and must stay reproducible. hierarchical runs a per-page shortlist then a cross-source reducer; its second LLM pass is accounted separately and must never be hidden inside the aggregator.

close_mode.description: prefix_preserving keeps the shared prompt prefix intact to exercise real prefix-cache reuse. fused_with_fallback belongs to C_FUSED_EXT only and always retains a dedicated-selector fallback for the two exit paths that do not call the fused tool.

selected_token_budget.description: The binding budget is the token count the deterministic renderer finally materializes downstream, NOT a cap on the number of IDs. Capping IDs instead would let a coarse chunker carry far more text for the same nominal budget, making the chunker comparison unfair.

variant_sha256.description: Digest of this record's canonical form, excluding this field. Identifies the design in freezes, figures and the final verdict.

is_control.description: True for P0, SHORT_PROSE and CPU_LEXICAL arms. Controls answer 'why did it win', and are excluded from champion promotion.
